Ranges.description: Sorted disjoint code point [start,end) ranges in LF-normalized source. End > start; total <= 1000.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Exact same origin. Existing owner-intent CSRF guard also applies.

CommunityKey.name: x-rock-community-keys
CommunityKey.description: JSON map containing only the one selected community ID to its 64-hex access key. Required when reading/saving restricted derived content or granting/approving egress. Not needed for invite acceptance or authority-reducing deletion/revocation.

trustedGateway.name: oai-authenticated-user-id
trustedGateway.description: Only accepted from existing trusted Sites dispatcher with host/dispatch validation. Never trust a client-supplied header. Device/eSIM/agent tokens are not human-owner consent.

Error404.description: Unavailable or not visible to this owner

Error409.description: Conflict; read back, do not overwrite or resend automatically

Error422.description: Policy, capacity, destination or budget rejected

Error503.description: Store, key or trusted clock unavailable

rules: Required for known restricted provenance. Reconstruct canonical renderer payload; current ACL/policy/author/destination required.
No provider call; keep existing 28000-byte limit, quote/parent budget and request ID rules.

rules: Known restricted provenance requires both restrictedSource and egressApproval. Server reconstructs final payload.
